context: The label above the left diagram reads “Logical structure of a heap (a heap is a complete binary tree).” The right reads “Physical structure of a heap (underlying storage: a complete binary tree represented by an array).” The horizontal array on the right holds 12 elements in level order, [9, 8, 6, 6, 7, 5, 2, 1, 4, 3, 6, 2], with indices increasing from 0 to 11 from left to right.
description: In the tree on the left, each circle has its array index below it. The root, 9 at index 0, has left child 8 at index 1 and right child 6 at index 2. The node at index 1 has children at indices 3 (value 6) and 4 (value 7). The node at index 2 has children at indices 5 (value 5) and 6 (value 2). The node at index 3 has children at indices 7 (value 1) and 8 (value 4). The node at index 4 has children at indices 9 (value 3) and 10 (value 6). In each pair, the left child comes first. The node at index 5 has only a left child, at index 11 (value 2).

The array illustrates how index formulas stand in for node pointers. Given index i, a non-root node's parent is at ⌊(i−1)/2⌋ (floor division), its left child at 2i+1, and its right child at 2i+2. Index i=4 (value 7) is highlighted in teal. A gray arrow points to its orange parent at ⌊(4−1)/2⌋ = 1 (value 8). Two arrows lead right from index 4 to its blue left child at 2×4+1 = 9 (value 3) and its blue-violet right child at 2×4+2 = 10 (value 6). Matching colors identify the same nodes in the tree and array.

frames.explanation: If a calculated child index is outside the array, that child does not exist. The root at index 0 has no parent. Compact level-order storage gives each node a unique index, so even nodes with equal values, such as the repeated 6s and 2s, can be distinguished.
frames.title: Array representation of a heap

result: The compact array representation of a complete binary tree needs no extra parent or child pointer fields. It takes O(1) time to compute the parent and child positions and check whether they exist.
summary: The same heap can be drawn as a complete binary tree or stored in level order in an array. Index formulas connect the two representations.
title: Array representation of a heap
